args.code:
import math

def control(obs):
    m=obs.get('local_map',{})
    left=m.get('left_rail',[])
    right=m.get('right_rail',[])
    def at(points,u):
        p=sorted((x,y) for x,y in points if x>0)
        if not p: return None
        for i in range(len(p)-1):
            if p[i][0]<=u<=p[i+1][0]:
                a,b=p[i],p[i+1]
                if b[0]-a[0]<1e-6: return a[1]
                return a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*(u-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0])
        return min(p,key=lambda q:abs(q[0]-u))[1]
    l=at(left,2.0); r=at(right,2.0)
    centre=(l+r)/2 if l is not None and r is not None else 0
    desired=max(-18,min(18,math.degrees(math.atan2(centre,2.0))*0.7))
    hitch=obs.get('hitch_deg',0)
    steer=max(-40,min(40,2.0*(hitch-desired)))
    return steer,-0.45,180

import math

def control(obs):
    m=obs.get('local_map',{})
    left=m.get('left_rail',[])
    right=m.get('right_rail',[])
    def at(points,u):
        p=sorted((x,y) for x,y in points if x>0)
        if not p: return None
        for i in range(len(p)-1):
            if p[i][0]<=u<=p[i+1][0]:
                a,b=p[i],p[i+1]
                if b[0]-a[0]<1e-6: return a[1]
                return a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*(u-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0])
        return min(p,key=lambda q:abs(q[0]-u))[1]
    l=at(left,2.0); r=at(right,2.0)
    centre=(l+r)/2 if l is not None and r is not None else 0
    desired=max(-18,min(18,math.degrees(math.atan2(centre,2.0))*0.7))
    hitch=obs.get('hitch_deg',0)
    steer=max(-40,min(40,2.0*(hitch-desired)))
    return steer,-0.45,180
